title: I swapped my 4-year-old iPhone 5S for a coral iPhone XR - and it's been a massive adjustment (AAPL)
text: I swapped my 4-year-old iPhone 5S for a coral iPhone XR — and it's been a massive adjustment (AAPL) By Lydia Ramsey Nov 16, 2018, 8:00 am 28 pts I'd been putting it off. Before October 26, I hadn't gotten a new phone since Christmas Eve 2014. I'd resisted the temptation of the new phones that my colleagues were reviewing, coveting the cameras their phones carry but telling myself that my iPhone 5S was still kicking, and therefore should be…
